title: Record Overview body table: keep totals of columns dropped for width
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Follow-up of #35742 (PR #35824). L1-a R1 is in record 7037129863.

## Problem
On the record page Overview, a master-detail body table now draws only the leading columns that fit whole. The other columns sit behind the ⤢ "All columns" button. When an omitted column is summed, its total leaves the body table's totals line too. A summed amount (for example a line amount) can vanish from Overview only because its column did not fit. It is still one click away under "All columns".

## Done when
One of these is true on the Overview body table, at any width that omits a summed column:
- (a) the totals line keeps the total of every omitted summed column, labelled with the column's name; or
- (b) the totals line says how many more totals sit in "All columns", for example "+2 totals in All columns", and that text opens the enlarged view.

The visible columns' totals are unchanged. A table that omits no column shows no added text.

## Where
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`: the body-table face (`bodyTableColumnsThatFit`, the column cap, and the totals row).
- Pins next to `RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx`.

## Not in scope
- The placement order and the 33/32 density (#35742).
- The non-body-table related list.
